message.content:
The most iconic sculpture of the 19th century is generally considered **“The Thinker” by Auguste Rodin**.  
Rodin began working on the piece in the 1880s, and its first cast appeared in 1902.  Although the final version was completed after the century ended, the work’s conception and early models were firmly rooted in the late‑19th‑century artistic milieu, and it has become a symbol of modern sculpture worldwide.
